'''20th Anniversary Collection''' is the 22nd virtual expansion for [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on November 28, 2014. The set consists of 19 virtual cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Doorway (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Doorway]]
*2 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (Federation)
*1 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*1 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*10 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (1 Dominion, 4 Federation, 2 Klingon, 4 Non-Aligned, 1 Starfleet)
*1 [[:Category:Q Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Q Dilemma]]
*2 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Borg and 1 Ferengi)

'''NOTE: '''There are 2 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*19 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
